patches.name: Block app open reports
patches.description: Stops the app from telling BuzzCast every time you open it.

patches.name: Disable trackers
patches.description: Stops the app from collecting your usage and advertising data.

patches.name: Hide first recharge popups
patches.description: Hides the first-recharge offer pop-ups.

patches.name: Hide home banner
patches.description: Hides the promotional banner in the middle of the home list.

patches.name: Hide join and follow messages
patches.description: Hides the "joined" and "followed" messages in live chats and the join banner at the top.

patches.name: Hide live room cards
patches.description: Hides the rotating event and gift cards in the corner of live rooms.

patches.name: Hide live room notice
patches.description: Removes the "healthy live streaming" message shown in every live chat.

patches.name: Hide rating prompts
patches.description: Stops the pop-ups that ask you to rate the app.

patches.name: Hide splash promo
patches.description: Skips the full-screen promotion shown when the app opens.

patches.name: Hide update prompt
patches.description: Stops the pop-up that asks you to update the app.

patches.name: Unlock SVIP
patches.description: Unlocks SVIP features and removes ads and purchase pop-ups.

patches.name: Restore trust on re-signed builds
patches.description: Lets Instagram's own checks of who signed the app pass on a patched build, so the parts that need them keep working.

patches.name: Story like history
patches.description: Keeps a local history of the stories you liked in the last 24 hours and shows it in a native grid, opened from the story "..." menu.

patches.name: Story mention indicator
patches.description: Shows an "@N mention" pill in the story header when the story mentions someone. Tap it to list and open the mentioned profiles.

patches.name: Instants Mod
patches.description: Adds a gallery button to post photos and videos, and allows saving friends' Instants to your device.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Enables unlimited local PREMIUM subscription in the mod's functions and remove forced update.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks premium features in Bisbi.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Disables ads (banner, interstitial, open, rewarded) and the consent pop-up.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Unlocks Car Scanner Pro features.

patches.name: Bypass signature check
patches.description: Prevents the app from closing automatically after being patched.

patches.name: Hide Try PRO button
patches.description: Removes the "Try PRO" pill from the home toolbar and the create tab.

patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Removes ads from Picsart.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks premium features in Picsart.

patches.name: Delete button in pin menu
patches.description: Replaces the WhatsApp button in the menu that opens when you press and hold your saved pin with a trash button that deletes it.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks premium camera features and removes license verification.

patches.name: Spoof signature
patches.description: Fixes push notifications on the patched app by spoofing the original signature.

patches.name: Tinder Block User Button
patches.description: Replaces the swipe screen's First Impression button with Tinder's block-user flow.

patches.name: Tinder Disable Consent Prompt
patches.description: Suppresses Tinder's in-house privacy/consent (TCF) pop-up. No consent is granted.

patches.name: Tinder Disable Paywall Flow
patches.description: Short-circuits Tinder's central paywall launcher so no paywall screen opens. Also blocks upgrade screens you open yourself.

patches.name: Tinder Disable Watch-an-Ad Sheet
patches.description: Hides the "watch an ad to keep swiping" bottom sheet shown when you are out of likes.

patches.name: Tinder Distance First
patches.description: Shows profile distance before Bio and Interests.

patches.name: Tinder Remove Ads
patches.description: Removes the ads shown between profiles in the swipe deck.

patches.name: Tinder Remove Upsell Dialogs
patches.description: Removes upsell pop-ups such as Platinum Likes, Boost, and Secret Admirer.

patches.name: Tinder Remove Upsells
patches.description: Removes sponsored chat messages and upsell pop-ups (Likes You, Boost).

patches.name: Tinder Unlimited Rewind
patches.description: Lets you rewind without the limit or paywall check.

patches.name: Remove ads and video blocking
patches.description: Removes banners and rewarded video ads when scheduling or favoriting.

patches.name: iCSee Remove Ads
patches.description: Removes the ads shown when the app opens and between screens.

patches.name: iCSee Remove Pop-ups
patches.description: Hides the promotion window that pops up on the main screens.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks all premium features in Image & Video Date Fixer.

patches.name: Keep timed media
patches.description: Stops photos, videos and voice messages with a timer from being treated as self-destructing media.

patches.name: Remove Telegraph ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored messages, video ads and the sponsored proxy.

patches.name: Remove Telegraph trackers
patches.description: Disables AppMetrica (usage analytics and crash reports).

patches.name: Remove forced update
patches.description: Removes the blocking dialog shown when Graph marks the installed version as outdated.

patches.name: Remove restrictions
patches.description: Allows copying, forwarding, saving and screenshots in restricted chats and channels.

patches.name: Remove third-party ad SDKs
patches.description: Blocks third-party ad networks bundled inside the app.

patches.name: Spoof Telegraph signature
patches.description: Restores original signature verification so the app can open after being patched.

patches.name: Unlock Telegraph Premium
patches.description: Makes Telegraph treat the current account as Premium and disables the app's own license/trial system (which also controls ad display). Client-side only; features that depend on the Telegram server still require a real Premium account.

repoDescription: Patch for Android application and implementation of new features.
